name: a hungry human leaves off wandering, eats at the fridge, and wanders again

steps.note: the fridge sits in cell (9, 5): x 9*48+24, y 5*48+24, and a map's objects are in pixels
zoomed out so the whole room is on screen at once

steps.shot: an empty kitchen with a fridge in it

steps.note: one human, in the far corner from the fridge; hunger is rolled at spawn

steps.shot: a new human, and what its mind is doing

steps.note: hunger rises a point a second and eating takes over at 60, so however hungry
it was born, a minute and a half of world is enough for it to walk over and eat

steps.shot: after a meal, and the brains menu saying so

steps.note: the menu follows the simulation, so it is still live as the world runs on
